Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 
 
 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
With reference to our letter dated 30th September 2026 providing the Schedule of Analyst or Institutional 
Investor Meeting with the Company, we wish to inform you that the Company participated in the Non-Deal 
Roadshow on 8th October 2026 in New York engaging with Funds, Investors etc. The said event concluded 
today at 1:00 a.m. (IST) [3:30 p.m. (EDT)].    
 
The presentation that was submitted to the Stock Exchange(s) vide our letter dated 30th July 2026 was 
presented during the event. 
 
The said presentation is also available on the Website of the Company at the Weblink: M&M Q1F27 Analyst 
Meet – Presentations deck – 30th July 2026  
 
Further, the Company has referred to publicly available documents for discussions and no unpublished price 
sensitive information has been shared during the aforesaid event. 
 
Kindly take the same on record. 
 
Yours sincerely, 
For Mahindra & Mahindra Limited
